races.name: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
JETEYE remains relatively unexposed over fences and can resume winning ways back at the scene of his ready victory in September. Luminaries looks ahead of the handicapper but had a hard race at Newcastle last week and this is a quick turnaround.

  1. JETEYE (IRE)
  2. LUMINARIES (IRE)
  3. PUDDLESINTHEPARK (IRE)

races.name: Green Howards Museum Richmond Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOMENT OF LIGHT progressed from his successful hurdles debut despite meeting with defeat at Market Rasen and can resume winning ways in a weak race following a breathing operation. Jambearee is the obvious choice for the forecast.

  1. MOMENT OF LIGHT
  2. JAMBEAREE (IRE)
  3. CAPTAIN BRUCE (IRE)

races.name: MW Civils And Groundworks Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
With her yard in tremendous form, point winner ANOTHER CLASSIC might be able to make a successful start under Rules in a thin maiden hurdle. Roxy Russet gave it a good go from the front at Fontwell and might not be far away again.

  1. ANOTHER CLASSIC (IRE)
  2. ROXY RUSSET
  3. MIDNIGHT BELLA

races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse For Outdoor Events Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
TREATY BOY capitalised on his much reduced mark at Kelso 10 days ago and remaining well treated on old form from 9 lb higher, Stuart Coltherd's 9-y-o looks to have an excellent chance of following up. He gets the nod over Prospect House, who possibly found Hexham coming too soon last time so can get back on track. Applejack Poet looks best of the rest.

  1. TREATY BOY (IRE)
  2. PROSPECT HOUSE (IRE)
  3. APPLEJACK POET (IRE)

races.name: Canine PREMIER FLEX Plus Joint Supplement Etc Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ELEMENTAL EYE could still have more to offer as a hurdler, especially at this sort of level, and is taken to defy a 3 lb higher mark for his Perth success in late-September. Snapaudaciaheros and Cadillac Ranch head the opposition.

  1. ELEMENTAL EYE
  2. SNAPAUDACIAHEROS (IRE)
  3. CADILLAC RANCH (IRE)

races.name: Sedgefield Christmas Jumper Raceday 22nd December Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A weak handicap and a good opportunity for CURIOUS MRS FOX, who's been knocking firmly on the door of late. Brave Move looks on a dangerous mark on the pick of his form for his previous yard and is second choice.

  1. CURIOUS MRS FOX
  2. BRAVE MOVE (IRE)
  3. ROCK ARMOUR (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Hurdle: gd to sft-gd in plcs; chase: gd-gd to sft in plcs; aw: standard to slow

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Open Maiden NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This probably won't take much winning and BURK FLIGHT looks the standout for a yard that has an excellent record in these events. Unbroken Spirit and Powerful Act both have smart Flat pedigrees so are worth a second look despite their cheap price tags.

  1. BURK FLIGHT (FR)
  2. UNBROKEN SPIRIT (IRE)
  3. POWERFUL ACT

races.name: John Marshall 80th Birthday Celebration Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ANALOGICAL probably has plenty more to come given his ability on the Flat and how he shaped on his hurdles bow for new connections at Uttoxeter last month, so he gets the vote. The Perfect Poet is worth another chance to confirm the promise of his bumper debut win, while fellow hurdles newcomer Ballyboy Prince needs keeping an eye on for the champion trainer.

  1. ANALOGICAL
  2. THE PERFECT POET
  3. BALLYBOY PRINCE (FR)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHOSEN HERO is potentially on a good mark on the pick of her form so gets the vote following a notable stable change. Everest and Little Lady Lucy are others to consider back down in class.

  1. CHOSEN HERO (IRE)
  2. EVEREST
  3. LITTLE LADY LUCY (IRE)

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Expensive French-recruit VIVRE LE REVE fared much better on his third start for this yard at Ffos Las in the spring and so could be worth chancing on handicap/chase bow. Away For The Night and Superstylin are solid alternatives.

  1. VIVRE LE REVE
  2. AWAY FOR THE NIGHT (IRE)
  3. SUPERSTYLIN (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CALSHOT SPIT is fit after a good run on the Flat and has dipped below his last winning mark in this sphere, so is taken to defy top weight. Market House and Cooler Than Me are feared most.

  1. CALSHOT SPIT (IRE)
  2. MARKET HOUSE (IRE)
  3. COOLER THAN ME

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A GREAT EXCUSE can bounce back with a bang starting out for an in-form yard. Fellow stable-switcher Onewayortother may offer most resistance.

  1. A GREAT EXCUSE (IRE)
  2. ONEWAYORTOTHER (FR)
  3. HELIOS ALLEN (FR)

races.name: Stan Mellor Memorial 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A match between 2 useful hurdlers. UN SENS A LA VIE's latest Market Rasen handicap success has a bit more substance than any of Loriko's small-field wins this summer and this 6-y-o, who is a chasing type in appearance, is preferred.

  1. UN SENS A LA VIE (FR)
  2. LORIKO (FR)

races.name: Alder Demain & Akers Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An interesting juvenile in which the vote goes to KELLY BURN for Dan Skelton but there are a few other likely types from the Flat, notably Thisonesforyou and Changing Lanes.

  1. KELLY BURN
  2. THISONESFORYOU
  3. CHANGING LANES

races.name: Alder Demain & Akers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TRIGG should prove hard to beat again despite his penalties. One Knight should have more to offer over hurdles based on his bumper form and may provide a bigger threat than Uttoxeter winner Nightflyer.

  1. TRIGG
  2. ONE KNIGHT (IRE)
  3. NIGHTFLYER (GER)

races.name: Alder Demain & Akers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BERRY EDGE should have more to come for Dan Skelton on the back of his Uttoxeter success and can deny Lucy The Wire the hat-trick. Woodstock City and Gallant Lion are others to consider in what looks a competitive race for the grade.

  1. BERRY EDGE (IRE)
  2. LUCY THE WIRE (IRE)
  3. WOODSTOCK CITY

races.name: Jets Richard Davis Awards Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A 5 lb rise doesn't look enough to prevent PLAYFUL FOX following up his Newton Abbot success. Fellow last-time-out winner Court In A Storm is the one likely to give him most to do.

  1. PLAYFUL FOX (FR)
  2. COURT IN A STORM (IRE)
  3. COASTGUARD STATION (IRE)

races.name: Alder Demain & Akers Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Perhaps BAHTIYAR can finally get his head in front, although I Love You Sivola has the potential to be a big threat if over his exertions at Worcester on Sunday.

  1. BAHTIYAR (FR)
  2. I LOVE YOU SIVOLA (FR)
  3. THE MAGUS (IRE)

races.name: Alex & Edward Alder Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BALLYMOREEN should have more to come on the back of her comfortable Fontwell handicap debut success and can make light of a 10 lb rise, perhaps at the expense of Electric Eddy who shaped well at Market Rasen until his stamina gave out. Kentucky River has improved over hurdles since stepped up in trip and is next on the list.

  1. BALLYMOREEN (IRE)
  2. ELECTRIC EDDY
  3. KENTUCKY RIVER (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MINI MAC has a less-than-ideal stall to overcome but James Owen's 4-y-o probably has enough in hand under a double penalty to complete the hat-trick. He gets the vote over Rovinia, who has plenty of decent efforts to his name this season and quickly returns to his optimum trip. Course specialist Bungle Bay rounds off the shortlist.

  1. MINI MAC (IRE)
  2. ROVINIA
  3. BUNGLE BAY (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
OPPENHEIMER became an umpteenth winning stable-switcher for this yard at Southwell on Saturday and despite a tricky-looking stall, he's fancied to follow up under a 6-lb penalty at the expense of Sonbelievable, who has made a solid start to life in handicaps. Barry The Worm is a different beast around here, so he's another expected to be in the shake-up.

  1. OPPENHEIMER (IRE)
  2. SONBELIEVABLE
  3. BARRY THE WORM

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CROWN OF IVY has been off since justifying market confidence in a Doncaster novice in May but that form has worked out well so he's taken to defy a penalty/absence for his new yard. Amandari's debut form at Yarmouth is also working out well so is next best.

  1. CROWN OF IVY (IRE)
  2. AMANDARI (IRE)
  3. MEHEN

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RED BLUE POINT took his form up a notch despite being turned over at odds on at Windsor in September and this looks a good opportunity for James Tate's colt to get off the mark. Time Teller took a significant step forward from his debut at Leicester 4 weeks ago and with better still to come, he looks the obvious threat. Debutant Striding rounds off the shortlist.

  1. RED BLUE POINT (IRE)
  2. TIME TELLER (IRE)
  3. STRIDING (IRE)

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict:
FANCY DANCER has largely been in good form of late and the booking of Loughnane catches the eye. Stash The Cash is on a handy mark and can come on for his recent run, while Beach Partee shouldn't be too far away, either.

  1. FANCY DANCER
  2. STASH THE CASH (IRE)
  3. BEACH PARTEE

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
ROGUE CITATION has been raised just 2 lb for her Southwell success last time and can be the answer in a race that may well pan out in a similar manner. Bintaziza and Star Mirage are a pair who also need consideration.

  1. ROGUE CITATION (IRE)
  2. BINTAZIZA (IRE)
  3. STAR MIRAGE (USA)

races.name: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
KINIRO has been in great form back on all-weather of late and gets the vote. Moving Force was very unlucky not to double up last time and rates the biggest danger from Lipsink.

  1. KINIRO
  2. MOVING FORCE (IRE)
  3. LIPSINK (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
TIGER BEETLE should take plenty of stopping if taking up this engagement and gets the nod from Virtual Hug. Arlecchino's Rex and Forever Perfect are others to consider.

  1. TIGER BEETLE
  2. VIRTUAL HUG (IRE)
  3. ARLECCHINO'S REX

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
JODHPUR BLUE just about holds the best claims with an eye-catching jockey booking tilting things in his favour. Barachiel and Caraway make most appeal of the rest.

  1. JODHPUR BLUE (FR)
  2. BARACHIEL (IRE)
  3. CARAWAY

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
SPECULATEUR belatedly opened his hurdles account at Sligo back in the spring and appealing as one who will excel over the larger obstacles now upped to 3m, Gordon Elliott's 5-y-o gets the verdict on return. Some Song represents the in-form Henry de Bromhead yard, and he could be the one to give the selection most to think about, with Caher Roes Den rounding off the shortlist.

  1. SPECULATEUR (FR)
  2. SOME SONG (IRE)
  3. CAHER ROES DEN (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
He may have taken a long time to get off the mark, but the manner of his recent Downpatrick win suggests SCHIEHALLION can make light of an 8 lb rise and go back-to-back. The enigmatic Ceroc has found some consistency of late, so he's put forward as the main danger back up in trip, with Mistyburn completing the shortlist.

  1. SCHIEHALLION (IRE)
  2. CEROC (IRE)
  3. MISTYBURN (IRE)

races.name: Winter Festival 28th & 29th November 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
SIR BENJI is the best of these on the Flat and could be the way to go before any betting clues. Maxminelli is another of the more likely contenders, while Mahzuz's hurdles experience will count for plenty.

  1. SIR BENJI (IRE)
  2. MAXMINELLI (IRE)
  3. MAHZUZ (IRE)

races.name: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
The level of form BON BON FIZZ has achieved in bumpers since falling on his hurdle debut suggests he should be more than capable of winning a maiden and he can enhance Gordon Elliott's good record in this race. Punchestown runner-up Quest For Answers is second choice ahead of Noel Meade's Downpatrick third Poets Rambler. Henry de Bromhead point recruit Bishop of Rome needs checking out in the betting.

  1. BON BON FIZZ (IRE)
  2. QUEST FOR ANSWERS (IRE)
  3. POETS RAMBLER (IRE)

races.name: Group Discounts For Winter Festival General Admission Rated Hurdle
races.verdict:
SAGEBOROUGH took a step back in the right direction when fourth of 17 in the Welsh Champion Hurdle at Chepstow on his latest outing and with the step up to 2½m appealing as a potential avenue for improvement, he shades the verdict at the weights. Generous Risk is feared most if bouncing back on his return to action for a yard which has an excellent record in this race, while Quinta Do Lago also merits respect given he remains unexposed at the trip.

  1. SAGEBOROUGH (FR)
  2. GENEROUS RISK (FR)
  3. QUINTA DO LAGO (FR)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
KAZBEK is weighted to turn around last month's Punchestown form with Another Challenge and may prove the answer for an in-form stable. Oliver McKiernan's charge may give him most to do ahead of the unexposed Colesberg. Jolly Potter is next on the list.

  1. KAZBEK (IRE)
  2. ANOTHER CHALLENGE (IRE)
  3. COLESBERG (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Veteran ANGELSWORKNOVRTIME has a decidedly ordinary strike rate but she's dropped to a very handy mark on the pick of her form and looks worth chancing with a recent run under her belt. Goin' can make his presence felt, especially if this pans out more favourably than on his most recent outing at Sligo, with Tudorista completing the shortlist.

  1. ANGELSWORKNOVRTIME (IRE)
  2. GOIN'
  3. TUDORISTA (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Fairyhouse December 12th Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A YEAR OLDER was successful on his last run over hurdles returning from 10 months off here on New Year's Day and is chanced to repeat the feat on his reappearance. Moonlight Paradise is another to consider, while it's hard to dismiss the in-form Moonshine Girl for all she faces a much different test than she did when winning at Galway last week.

  1. A YEAR OLDER (IRE)
  2. MOONLIGHT PARADISE (IRE)
  3. MOONSHINE GIRL (IRE)
